name: A Ma Maniére x Air Jordan 5 Retro 'Dusk'
story_html: The A Ma Maniére x Air Jordan 5 Retro ‘Dusk’ reunites the creative partners on a two sneaker collaborative pack. This pair carries a black nubuck upper, updated with a slimmed-down collar and pre-yellowed quarter panel netting formed with an interlocking series of A Ma Maniére’s signature ‘A’ logo. ‘Nike Air’ branding is embroidered on the back heel in tonal fashion, while silver reflective tongues display mismatched Jumpman and A Ma Maniére branding. The sneaker sits atop a matching black polyurethane midsole with shark-tooth detailing in a dark burgundy hue. A pre-aged translucent rubber outsole featuring the Atlanta-based retailer’s logo provides durable traction underfoot.
